evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 泽兰堂
evidence.excerpt_zh: 由寳相寺度城關而東迤南為翠交軒軒下石室為熙春洞北為愛山樓又北為澤蘭堂（長春園册）臣等謹案愛山樓上額曰天風海濤樓下額曰山静雲閒澤蘭堂額曰神觀蕭爽
evidence.summary: East of 寳相寺 through a walled gate: 翠交軒 with the stone room 熙春洞 under it, 愛山樓 and 澤蘭堂. The note gives plaques.

evidence.title: 翠交轩八韵
evidence.locator: v3 p.358, under 泽兰堂; source ref 8-425
evidence.excerpt_zh: 假山植真树，岁久翠阴交。甘露常承叶，祥云每压梢。瑞图休鼓舞，理趣喜含包。不有四时运，谁明六位爻。隙中无碍远，密处自相捎。未许蛛悬网，惟应鹊缮巢。张如碧油伞，伴合绿琼勹。最爱微风拂，琳枝飒沓敲。
evidence.summary: Poem 翠交轩八韵 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1761, filed by the editors under 泽兰堂.

evidence.title: 翠交轩石生柏子叠辛巳旧作韵
evidence.locator: v3 p.360, under 泽兰堂; source ref 14-636
evidence.excerpt_zh: 寒燠四时运，阴阳二气交。窍心育根柢，块面长枝梢。茂已柏花吐，粗将石孔包。蕃鲜震标象，磊珂艮陈爻。霭霭祥云护，瀼瀼瑞露捎。玉蟾应驻窟，凡鸟敢移巢。茵俯青苔纽，竿依绿笋勹。载观求应处，堪以畅吟敲。
evidence.summary: Poem 翠交轩石生柏子叠辛巳旧作韵 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1782, filed by the editors under 泽兰堂.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v3, editors' note on 泽兰堂
evidence.summary: On the south slope of the northern hill, south of 大水法; begun 1746 and known for rockwork. 萃交轩 with the grotto 熙春洞 below, 爱山楼, pavilion 环碧; 泽兰堂, a five-bay high-terrace hall, and 理性居 were added in 1759. Used as a study, and the best view over the fountains.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.

plan_ref.text: Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01), labelled 翠交轩, 3x1 cells.
